sections.heading: Proportional controls help you enjoy the body at its intended pace.
paragraphs: The simple SLT2 radio is appropriate for slow placement on an indoor or nearby outdoor course. Its throttle limiter can reduce available output during the first sessions, but there is no reason to quote a precise reduced road speed. RC Driver's current 4Runner coverage is attributable outside running, including observations about the body and setup. We have not reproduced those runs. The SCX24 Toyota 4Runner control system is listed as Spektrum SLT2; 2-in-1 ESC/receiver. Treat the manual as the reference for binding, reversing, neutral settings and any assistance function supplied with this exact package. Check steering trim on the surface you intend to use, then verify response in both directions before a demanding session. For shared casual use, explain how to stop and shut down the vehicle before handing the controls to another driver. If the car behaves incorrectly, distinguish a setting issue from physical binding. A new electronic part is a poor first response when the existing linkage is prevented from moving freely.

sections.heading: Oil damping is useful equipment, and body clearance still matters.
paragraphs: The 4Runner has 6mm oil shocks and a three-link front/four-link rear solid-axle layout in the official description. Damping offers more controlled suspension movement than an undamped spring alone, but it does not remove the effects of body height and weight distribution. Before fitting taller tires or longer shocks, check full steering and articulation clearance with the existing hard shell. Raising the body to cure a tire rub changes more than appearance, so record the original settings and choose one alteration at a time.

The published construction for SCX24 Toyota 4Runner is steel chassis rails; 6mm oil shocks; abs hard body. Those details describe what an owner can inspect and maintain; they do not provide a measured suspension or steering score. Use the original mounting positions as a reference and check movement before changing springs, shock positions or link lengths. Its listed wheelbase is 132 mm, which makes exact replacement compatibility more useful than a generic Axial parts search. Confirm tire clearance through steering travel and suspension movement with the body installed. Change one mechanical setting at a time, record the new position and return to the baseline if the result becomes confusing. A good tuning process should explain the change you are seeking, rather than replace several components at once and leave you unable to identify which one helped.

sections.heading: The Toyo tires belong on obstacles scaled to the vehicle.
paragraphs: Pro-Line Toyo Open Country R/T Trail tires and Mini Impulse bead-lock wheels provide the stock contact package. They are a specific included feature, not proof of a best-in-class grip result. RC Driver notes limited walking speed and a relatively top-heavy hard-body presentation in its own coverage. Those observations make it sensible to choose tight technical courses rather than long hikes. I would use dry rocks or a clean indoor layout with gradual crests, giving the truck a chance to approach without repeatedly rolling from a sharp edge.

The SCX24 Toyota 4Runner tire package is Pro-Line Toyo Open Country R/T Trail; Mini Impulse wheels. Its intended terrain listing is indoor and off-road. Begin on a surface that lets you observe a consistent response, then adjust the course rather than immediately blaming the tire. The published dimensions are 221 × 105 × 97 mm. They help plan the space and transport requirements, but they do not establish measured grip, rollover angle or jump behavior.
